definitions.explanation: Sesame seeds with a pale cream to white hull. The most commonly used variety of sesame in Japanese cooking, with a mild, delicate flavor.

examples.japanese: {白|しろ}ごま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}りかける→振りかける：21485_furikakeru⟧。
{白|しろ}ごま⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げ→仕上げ：11519_shiage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: White sesame is often used as a finishing touch in cooking.

examples.japanese: {白|しろ}ごま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擂|す}って⟦ドレッシング→ドレッシング：11126_doresshingu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜる→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦まろやか→まろやか：09207_maroyaka⟧な⟦{風味|ふうみ}→風味：14622_fuumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you grind white sesame and mix it into the dressing, it gives a mellow flavor.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧ (white) and ごま (⟦{胡麻|ごま}→胡麻：10337_goma⟧, sesame). White sesame is the most commonly used sesame variety in Japan, accounting for the majority of sesame consumption. It has a milder flavor than ⟦{黒|くろ}ごま→黒ごま：23455_kurogoma⟧ (black sesame).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白|しろ}ごま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擂|す}る: to grind white sesame
- ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧⟦{炒|い}りごま→炒りごま：23447_irigoma⟧: toasted white sesame
- ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧{擂|す}りごま: ground white sesame
- {白|しろ}{練|ね}りごま: white sesame paste

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{黒|くろ}ごま→黒ごま：23455_kurogoma⟧: black sesame seeds — stronger, nuttier flavor; popular in sweets
- {金|きん}ごま: golden sesame seeds — a rarer variety with a rich aroma
- ⟦{胡麻|ごま}→胡麻：10337_goma⟧: sesame — the general term
- ⟦{炒|い}りごま→炒りごま：23447_irigoma⟧: toasted sesame — the most common prepared form
- ⟦すりごま→すりごま：23164_surigoma⟧: ground sesame

USAGE:
White sesame appears everywhere in Japanese cooking: as a garnish on rice, in ⟦{胡麻|ごま}→胡麻：10337_goma⟧{和|あ}え (sesame-dressed vegetables), in dressings and sauces, and in {白|しろ}ごま⟦プリン→プリン：11123_purin⟧ (white sesame pudding). On packaging, look for ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧⟦いり→いる：00495_iru⟧ごま (toasted) or {白|しろ}すりごま (ground).
